questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion to emphasise the speaker’s surprise about the situation?
options: It was surprising that she had already finished the report by midnight.
Only when she left did I realise how much I had enjoyed the meeting.
Had she not been exhausted, she would have stayed longer to help.
The fact that he arrived late was entirely his own fault.
questions.answer: Only when she left did I realise how much I had enjoyed the meeting.

questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates the use of the cleft construction to separate the subject and object of a complex clause?
options: What matters most is that she committed to the project without hesitation.
It was not until he received the letter that he understood the true nature of the situation.
The reason she left early was because she felt overwhelmed by the workload.
What surprised me was how quickly he adapted to the new role.
questions.answer: What matters most is that she committed to the project without hesitation.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs a third conditional structure to express a hypothetical scenario in the past with regret?
options: If she had studied harder, she would have passed the exam.
He would have called you if he had known the time.
She regretted not having told him the truth sooner.
If I had known the cost, I would not have bought the item.
questions.answer: If she had studied harder, she would have passed the exam.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical situation that contradicts reality?
options: He wishes he could travel to Paris again.
She insists that we leave immediately.
They demand that the meeting be rescheduled for next week.
I recommend that you take the medicine twice daily.
questions.answer: She insists that we leave immediately.

questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates the use of ellipsis and formal register to convey a nuanced meaning of implied agreement?
options: You must admit, he has a very impressive collection of vintage cars.
It is clear that his argument lacks sufficient evidence.
She never fails to remind me that we should have discussed this earlier.
I suggest that we proceed with caution before making any final decisions.
questions.answer: You must admit, he has a very impressive collection of vintage cars.
